about.title: About
about.metaDescription: What Olim is, where the data comes from, and how to reach us. A free, independent adaptation navigator for new immigrants in Israel.
about.lead: Olim is a free adaptation navigator for new immigrants to Israel. Take a short quiz and get a personal plan: what to do, and when, after your move.
about.independentBody: This is a non-commercial project, not affiliated with any government body. We sell nothing and guarantee nothing — we only help you get oriented and point you to official sources.
about.sourcesBody: We rely on official sources and show a verification date on every step:
about.sourceGov: gov.il — Israeli ministries (Aliyah & Integration and others)
about.sourceKolzchut: Kol Zchut — the rights encyclopedia (has Russian)
about.sourceBituach: Bituach Leumi — the National Insurance Institute
about.sourceNativ: Nativ — consular checks for FSU countries
about.disclaimerBody: Deadlines, sums and rules change. Always verify against the official source — we link it on every step.
about.feedbackBody: What's unclear, what's missing, what's annoying — tell us:
